छग छग, अस्, आ, m. f. (said to be fr. rt. छो),
a goat; [cf. छाग; cf. also Germ. Bock; Angl. Sax.
bucca; Old Germ. boch, poch, pog; Lat. caper;
hircus (?); Hib. gabhar.]

छाग छाग, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. छो),
a goat; the sign of the zodiac Aries; N. of one of
the attendants of Śiva; (ई), f. a she-goat; (अस्, ई,
अम्), coming from or relating to a goat or she-
goat.
—छाग-भोजिन्, ई, m. a wolf, (‘goat-eater.’)
—छाग-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, like a goat or she-goat.
—छाग-मित्र, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—छाग-
मित्रिक, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, relating to Chāga-mitra.
—छाग-रथ, अस्, m. Agni the god of fire (whose
vehicle is the goat).
—छाग-लक्षण, अम्, n., N.
of a Pariśiṣṭa attributed to Kātyāyana.
—छाग-
वाहन, अस्, m. Agni the deity of fire.

छगल, अस्, m. a goat; a N. of Atri; of a
Muni; of a country; (आ, ई), f. a she-goat; a kind of
convolvulus, see the next; (अम्), n. blue cloth or
raiment; [cf. छागल.]
—छगलाङ्घ्री (˚ल-अङ्˚)
or छगलाण्डी (˚ल-अण्˚), f. a plant, see the next.
—छगलान्त्रिका or छगलान्त्री (˚ल-अन्˚), f.
the plant Argyreia Speciosa or Argentea; a wolf;
[cf. अजान्त्री.]

छागल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. छगल), coming from
or relating to a goat or to a she-goat, caprigenous;
born in Chagala; (अस्), m. a goat; a kind of fish,
= छागलक; a patronymic from Chagala (when
a descendant of Atri is to be designated); N. of a
mountain.
—छागलान्त्रिका, f. a kind of plant, =
छगलान्त्रिका.
—छागलान्त्री (˚ल-अन्˚), f. a wolf;
also = छगलान्त्री.
छागलक, अस्, m. a kind of fish.

छगलिन्, ई, m., N. of a preceptor who was him-
self a pupil of Kalāpin; [cf. छागलेयिन्.]

छगण छगण, अस्, अम्, m. n. dried cow-
dung; [cf. छागण.]

छागण छागण, अस्, m. a fire of dried cow-
dung (छगण).

छागलि, इस्, m. a metronymic from Chagalā and a
patronymic from Chagala; a descendant of Atri; N.
of a prince.

छागलेय, N. of a place; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a
school; (अस्), m., N. of the author of a law-book.

छागलेयिन्, इनस्, m. pl. the pupils of Chagalin;
the Sūtras of the pupils of Chagalin.
छागेय, आस्, m. pl., N. of a school.
छाग्यायनि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Chāga.
